reviews.text: Thank you for rating our team 5/5! :)
Been going here for 11 years now. Great with my temperamental dog
Friendly staff that know what they are talking about

We had our gorgeous dog here yesterday for the last time. Unfortunately she was laid to sleep and we were very anxious and upset. One of the vets Emma I am sure was fantastic. She was very calm. Great with our dog and extremely respectful. She put our dog at rest and was really good with myself and my wife. The girls on front desk were equally as nice. There professional manner and caring words really helped ease the burden as much as could be expected. After she had gone they gave us a private room and all the time we needed to say goodbye. Im embarrassed to say I dont think I thanked emma but I could hardly bring any words up. If I didnt I am sorry and pass on eternal gratitude from me my wife and our pup marley. Thank you all for your sympathy and for being so caring.

We had our chocolate working cocker spaniel Abbey registered here for 6 years. We had moved over 30 miles away so we needed a new practice but in the 6 years we had Abbey registered here, we found Stuan and the staff great to deal with and they always put Abbey at ease. They were very ethical and charged fairly for what they did. Abbey passed away this week from pancreatic and liver cancer that started very suddenly.   Thank you very much for the services over the years. This is a great practice to have your dog at.

I never normally do reviews but just needed to share praise for this practice in their brilliant care for my elderly cat over the last week.  Angelique has taken amazing care of him, kept me fully informed at all times and absolutely put my mind at rest.  He ended up admitted last minute this morning and despite my anxiety I left the practice totally confident that the amazing staff would take great care of him.  Tonight, despite having had general anaesthetic earlier, he is already more like his normal self.  He was clearly incredibly well taken care of and treated with kindness by both Angelique and the nurses involved, I really cannot thank them enough.

The vet I dealt with was so nice and caring she showed so much compassion to me when i had to bring my wee dog Maisey in to be put to sleep after discovering she had cancer the only thing I don’t like and it’s maybe a suggestion to the business is when people like myself are finding it hard to come in when picking ashes up we are treated with a bit of dignity there should be a room your took into when coming to pick up ashes ‘ my heart was breaking waiking in to pick my baby up just to stand there and be handed a gift bag and told there you go like it’s a parcel am picking up 😞 it’s hard enough to go through the grief of losing a pet but to stand at reception way all other dogs around is even harder to be waiking away with your animal in a bag empathy compassion kindness and dignity doesn’t cost anything in this life

The best vets I’ve used
Really care about your pet

I don't normally leave reviews, but I had to leave a review based on my experience yesterday. I had to take my pet rat to be put down sadly, and the vet Rachel could not have been nicer. She was empathetic, she was kind, she even offered to get paw prints of my rat after she had passed to get alongside her ashes. And she even offered to bring someone from the front desk to come into the examination room for payment as me and my other half were both crying. She is a shining example of what a vet should be like and I cannot praise her or this vet practice enough. Thank you again!

They have done an amazing job at looking after my lovely girl. She was in for a diagnostic that I was quite nervous about because she was meant to be sedated for it and they did their due diligence before giving her the sedative drugs and pre-screened her heart health to ensure pet safety. I felt my cat was in very safe hands the entire time and the team were very communicative about every aspect of the procedure and the findings of her health. The reception staff are kind and vet/nurse staff were very thorough and helpful. I would happily recommend this practice to fellow pet owners, they know what they’re doing in here.

Took my wee Rabbit to vets for pets and had a bit of an issue, the Lady Nikki on the front desk was great so so helpful, sorted everything out for me when she didn’t need to, got my rabbit in for her jag and all the staff that took part were absolutely great.
Great team and would definitely recommend them.
had an early morning appointment - left my cat to get her  spayed brought her back home on same shes is all good no issues with never touch her stiches which was a surpise

Very lovely team. Always had a great experience with both getting my cats neutered and with one of my cats who had cystitis. Angelique is a great vet. Also have the care plan which has been great. Had nothing majorly serious but both the vets and nurses seem very attentive and haven't been pushy on expensive treatments either, even informing me it is cheaper to get my cystitis supplement elsewhere online

I was sent here by my usual Vets4Pets branch for an Animal Health Cerificate and was told the costs would be around £120. My dog was already vaccinated for rabies so the only thing which was needed was to scan his chip and fill out the forms. I was charged £263 for a few minutes of paperwork which is absolutely disgusting. Not only that but he didn't even look once at my dog to assess his health. Don't come here, you will be fleeced for as much as possible.
So cute, but I didn’t buy one

Hi, Thank you for our service review! 
We appreciate you taking the time, if we can be of any other help, please contact the practice:)

I took in a hedgehog that I had found in the middle of a very busy road at 9.30am.

I managed to lift it and took it to this practice. I asked if they could check it and they said it was an SSPCA issue!!!

I said if you check it and it’s ok I can take it home, feed it and release it to somewhere grassy tonight.

She said all we will do is put it to sleep

I was scared it was injured or unwell.
I said I start work in 90 mins, I don’t know what to do. I had to agree and left feeling so upset that regardless of being ‘wildlife’ it still deserved to care from the very caregivers of all animals domestic or wildlife.

I just wondered if I’d offered to pay that the outcome would have been different (I know Vets have a duty of care to wildlife) ♥️

Definitely not this practices finest hour
Thank you so much for taking the time to share your experience!

Dropping my cat off at the vet. Receptionists were friendly. The nurse was also very friendly, polite and gentle with my cat. Walked me through all the forms and explaining all the options I had  as well. The room was also nice and sanitised as I could see the anti bacterial wipes as well.

I’ve never felt so disappointed and dismissed by a veterinary clinic. The customer service at Vets4Pets has been consistently poor, especially from the receptionist, who speaks to clients with an attitude that’s more cold and condescending than caring.

Trying to get through on the phone is already frustrating enough, but once you do, you’re met with rushed, dismissive communication that makes you feel like an inconvenience rather than a paying client concerned about your pet. No empathy, no professionalism.

To make matters worse, the veterinary care itself felt undertrained and uncertain. basic questions were met with vague responses, and I left feeling more confused than reassured. It’s hard to trust a place with your pet’s wellbeing when both the front of house and clinical staff lack care and clarity.

I won’t be returning, and I’d advise others to consider alternative clinics where compassion and competence are actually part of the service.
Lovely vets
Highly recommend, very kind staff and care for my cat, They even clean my cat's knots for free!

Always very lovely with my happy little kittens, even when they run around and try and climb their computers! One of my kittens was very sick when I got him and they were always happy to give advice over the phone for free and advise where i can get the medicine cheapest

Worst vet I've ever been too. Had to take my cat for a sore eye, the check-up was £48 which was fine because they ran a few tests. Then the eye drops and medicine was £115. I found the eye drops online for £10 and the medicine for £20. Then got told we had to go back a few days later for them to check her over. The vet looked at her eye and said it looks better than her colleague said then charged us another £48. FOR WHAT? I could have said it looked better for free. I'll never be back. If they really cared about the health and wellbeing of animals they wouldn't squeeze every penny they could out of people.
